title: Roll response (rate and time constant)
objective: To demonstrate that the simulator roll-rate response to roll control input conforms to the validation data.
tolerance_catalog: ± 10% or ± 2º/s roll rate | ± 10% or ± 0.1 s roll time constant (tau) | ± 2º bank angle
runtime_configuration: Existing main.py test settings and common engine remain authoritative
